title: Smallest executable retrieval/counter-authority RECALL@K benchmark that can falsify the product's reranking leg, built on the frozen 24-cell multilingual cache
fast_mvp_directive: FAST MVP MODE: build the smallest executable retrieval/counter-authority benchmark that can falsify the product. Reuse existing multilingual/provenance tests. No universal-174k reruns.
why_this_cycle: Three facts, each checked against committed bytes this cycle. (1) LANE GAP (round-0 audit observations O1/O2): the accepted suite tests/evaluation/test_retrieval_benchmark.py advertises known relevant-authority recall and known contrary/limiting-authority recall in its own docstring, but KNOWN_RELEVANT is [] for 3 of 4 queries, KNOWN_COUNTER is [] for all 12 cells, helper _recall_at_k is never invoked by any test, and _run_offline_retrieval(query, lang) ignores both arguments and always returns the single DE fixture bundle. The accepted suite therefore executes ZERO recall legs: it cannot falsify retrieval quality. The lane's own directive requires known relevant-authority recall and known contrary/limiting-authority recall where feasible. (2) THE FROZEN INPUTS ARE ALREADY NON-VACUOUS: evaluation/retrieval_gate/frozen_retrieval_benchmark.json (sha256 187b0e54...) carries 9 authority_ids and 28 known_counter_ids across 4 questions, and results/evaluation/retrieval_benchmark/cache/ holds all 24 FR/DE/IT x baseline/counter envelopes that the accepted cached-replay gates already score. The ground truth exists; only the executable rank-sensitive leg is missing. The accepted frozen test file is sha-pinned (protocol digest e1a0b18d...) and may NOT be edited to close this gap, so the fix is a NEW file, never a repair of the frozen one. (3) ZERO-DELTA EXCLUSION OF ORDERED ITEM (2): the post-repair family falsifier was last executed at accepted product head 8e58724b (accept product cycle 40128639259). This cycle's mount is e53662be (accept product cycle 40139832004), and git diff 8e58724b..e53662be -- results/product/ is EMPTY (only product/tests/test_canvas_ring_strokes.py, results/audit/product/CYCLE_40139832004_GATE.json, reports/audit/product/CYCLE_40139832004.md and state/product.json changed). Every claim-bearing input byte of item (2) is unchanged, so re-running it would be a zero-delta repair, which is invalid. This cycle therefore spends its delta on (1)+(2): a genuinely new executable recall instrument.
what_is_new_relative_to_the_benchmark_of: The benchmark of record (accepted test suite, 38 tests) proves candidate validity, dedupe, determinism, provenance, source validity and FR/DE/IT structural robustness, and it pins its own protocol digest - but its recall helpers are dead code (O1/O2). The accepted instruments complement it from the other side: mapping_free_recall_falsifier measures concept coverage over SERVED packets with a mechanical admissibility predicate, and post_repair_family_ca_falsifier adjudicates the item-(2) precondition plus counter-evidence defects on post-repair bundles. Neither measures whether the product's TF-IDF reranker DROPS a frozen known authority that its own candidate input already contained. This instrument adds exactly that one missing rank-sensitive leg: same frozen corpus, two orderings (input/OCL order versus product.retrieve() order), one relative claim, no invented threshold.

population_FROZEN.cells: Exactly evaluation.retrieval_gate.run_retrieval_benchmark.build_query_plan(frozen spec) = 4 questions x 2 channels (baseline, counter) x 3 languages (fr, de, it) = 24 cells, in frozen plan order (channel x language per question, question order as in the spec).
population_FROZEN.corpus_per_cell: The rows of that cell's cached envelope, offline-replayed through evaluation.retrieval_gate.client.SearchClient(offline=True), kept in OpenCaseLaw return order. That order IS the baseline ordering under test (the order in which candidates arrive at the product). Corpus size: 50 rows for baseline cells, 30 rows for counter cells (spec top_k).
population_FROZEN.ground_truth_per_cell: baseline channel -> question.authority_ids (frozen; 0 for rent-default, 2 corporate-criminal-liability, 5 business-judgment-rule, 2 petty-theft-dismissal = 9 ids). counter channel -> question.known_counter_ids (9 / 6 / 4 / 9 = 28 ids). No analyst mapping of any kind is consumed: both sets are read verbatim from the frozen spec.
population_FROZEN.id_matching: REUSED, not re-derived: evaluation.retrieval_gate.gates.row_cores(row, min_len=6) on each retrieved row and evaluation.retrieval_gate.frozen.alnum_core(gid) on each ground-truth id, i.e. the frozen spec's own id_match_rules implemented by the accepted gates module. A ground-truth id is 'present' in a cell iff its alnum core appears in some row's cores; its rank under an ordering is the minimum index of a row carrying that core.
population_FROZEN.query_per_cell: question['queries'][channel][lang], verbatim from the frozen spec (the same text the envelope was fetched with).
population_FROZEN.product_ordering: product.query.retrieval.retrieve(query, corpus, top_n=len(corpus)) over docs built as {decision_id, full_text: gates.row_text(raw_row), court, language, canonical_url} where gates.row_text = title + regeste + snippet with highlight markup stripped (FULL text, not the 600-char text_head). retrieve() internally uses expand_query(query)[-1] and full_text[:8000] - the product's own accepted machinery, unmodified.
population_FROZEN.k_values: PRIMARY k = 20, the claim is evaluated at k = 20. SECONDARY k = 10, published as context only and never used to decide the verdict.
population_FROZEN.discriminating_cell_rule: A cell enters the claim iff |gt| > 0 AND >= 1 ground-truth id is present in its corpus (coverage > 0). Recon says 10 of 24 cells qualify; the other 14 are published NOT_MEASURED.

hypothesis: On the frozen 24-cell multilingual population, the product's query-conditioned reranking leg (product.query.retrieval.retrieve over its own expanded-query TF-IDF) does NOT lose frozen known-relevant or known-counter authorities that the candidate input order itself keeps in its top-20: for every discriminating cell, product_retention@20 >= baseline_retention@20, and in aggregate product_hits@20 >= baseline_hits@20, and no language in which the baseline retains a ground-truth id falls to zero product retention. A bounded negative is fully acceptable and is an expected outcome of this instrument: if the reranker drops even one such id in any discriminating cell, the product claim under test is FALSIFIED and the run exits 1. If zero cells discriminate, the instrument must exit 2 NOT_MEASURED_VACUOUS, which is never a pass.

metrics_FROZEN.coverage: |gt present in cell corpus| / |gt| - reach of the frozen OCL search itself, reported as context and explicitly NOT part of the claim (the accepted cached-replay gates already publish this reach).
metrics_FROZEN.recall_at_k: |gt in first k positions of ordering O| / |gt|, denominator = FULL frozen gt set, so ids absent from the corpus count as misses (standard IR recall). Reported for baseline and product orderings at k=20 and k=10.
metrics_FROZEN.retention_at_k: |gt in first k positions of ordering O| / |gt present in corpus|, null when coverage = 0. THIS is the claim metric: it isolates the reranker from the search layer's reach.
metrics_FROZEN.aggregate: Sum of hits divided by sum of denominators over discriminating cells only (micro-average), per channel and per gt class, plus a per-language micro-average for the language leg.

success_rule_FROZEN.benchmark_validity: The CYCLE succeeds iff the run exits 0 or 1 with all seven controls passing: an exit-1 result (honest falsification) is a VALID, publishable benchmark outcome, not a cycle failure. Only exit 2 (vacuous/environment) or a crash is a cycle failure.
success_rule_FROZEN.product_claim_rule: Verdict BENCHMARK_VALID_NO_FALSIFICATION (exit 0) iff ALL of: (a) every discriminating cell satisfies product_retention@20 >= baseline_retention@20; (b) micro-aggregate product_hits@20 >= baseline_hits@20 over discriminating cells; (c) the language leg holds for every language (no language with baseline_hits@20 > 0 has product_hits@20 < baseline_hits@20).
success_rule_FROZEN.falsification_rule: Verdict PRODUCT_FALSIFIED_RECALL_LOSS (exit 1) if any of (a) (b) (c) is violated. Every violating cell is published with its gt ids, input rank and product rank.
success_rule_FROZEN.vacuity_rule: Verdict NOT_MEASURED_VACUOUS (exit 2) if zero cells discriminate, or if any control fails, or if the frozen spec digest drifts. Exit 2 is never a pass and never a bar met.

controls_FROZEN.rule: sha256 of evaluation/retrieval_gate/frozen_retrieval_benchmark.json equals 187b0e54b03b326c62d45d8ba48fc78dc88501086761cd91a84c304a7478ba72 both before and after execution (frozen.load_frozen() digest check must not raise).

For each of the 24 cells, sha256 of the offline cache bytes equals the raw_sha256 recorded by the replay record, and the ids_sha256 recomputed from the extracted rows equals the recorded ids_sha256 (provenance tie to the accepted cache).
Metric liveness: feeding an empty product ordering yields product_recall@20 = 0 and product_retention@20 = 0.0 in EVERY discriminating cell. Proves the metric can fail (kills vacuous-truth).

Metric liveness: feeding an oracle ordering that puts every present ground-truth row first yields product_recall@20 = 1.0 and product_retention@20 = 1.0 in EVERY discriminating cell. Proves the metric can reach its maximum (kills saturating-at-zero).

At least one discriminating cell exists; the frozen gt totals must be 9 authority ids and 28 counter ids across 4 questions, and at least one authority id and one counter id must be present somewhere. Otherwise exit 2.
Calling product.retrieve twice on the same (query, corpus) returns an identical decision_id sequence, and offline replay of the 24 cells twice yields identical per-cell id sequences.

REUSED accepted predicates: evaluation.retrieval_gate.gates.source_rows_valid and gates.unique_ids evaluated over the replayed record - canonical_url https + mcp.opencaselaw.ch, language in (fr,de,it), non-empty decision_id, no duplicate alnum core within a cell. Failure blocks exit 0.

controls_REPORTED_ONLY.rule: Wall-clock of product.retrieve per cell and aggregate: PUBLISHED ONLY, no threshold invented (the frozen spec's latency budgets govern live transport, not TF-IDF rerank; inventing a rerank budget would be a new bar).

verdict_vocabulary.BENCHMARK_VALID_NO_FALSIFICATION: exit 0 - controls pass, non-vacuous, no recall loss found
verdict_vocabulary.PRODUCT_FALSIFIED_RECALL_LOSS: exit 1 - controls pass, non-vacuous, at least one frozen cell/language/aggregate loses a ground-truth id under the product ordering that the input ordering kept
verdict_vocabulary.NOT_MEASURED_VACUOUS: exit 2 - zero discriminating cells or a control failed or spec digest drifted; never a pass
verdict_vocabulary.ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: exit 2 - product package or dependencies unavailable; never a pass

claim_ceiling: Exactly one claim, relative and non-calibrated: on these 24 cached OpenCaseLaw cells, with these frozen id sets and k=20, the product reranker does or does not lose ground-truth authorities that its own input order kept. It does NOT claim absolute retrieval quality, a bar met, serving readiness, human_gate_ready (stays false), jurist utility, calibrated uncertainty, answer correctness, or any property of live network retrieval (all network calls are off). Coverage limitation is disclosed: only 10 of 24 cells discriminate and only 18 of 111 gt id-cells are present, so a PASS means 'no loss observed on the discriminating cells', never 'retrieval works'. Corpus docs use gates.row_text (title+regeste+snippet), not the product's production full_text pipeline; the corpus is the per-cell OCL response, not the product's unioned and deduped pipeline. No universal-174k benchmark, no 174k HNSW/citation-heritage rerun, no network calls, no new threshold, no new label, no editing of any frozen artifact.
